fireflies.prompt:

Replace the dots with exactly 16 SMALL warm GOLDEN glowing points, mixed tiny sizes, spread within the existing jar body's footprint x=300–730 y=490–780 on a 1024-equivalent canvas. ONLY the fireflies layer, no jar, no glass fill, no lid, no other objects. Keep square canvas and all outside fully transparent. Match the attached style sheet exactly. original design, no logos, no brand names or brand shapes, no characters, no text.

Match the attached style sheet exactly.
